objective: Move the owner-facing realtime AI Resources dashboard out of legacy App.vue into a dedicated typed Vue page while preserving App.vue as the only owner of polling, resource-control IPC, scheduler state and live telemetry lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not alter VRAM limits, scheduler admission, model force-load/unload behavior, poll interval, telemetry collection, provider residency, or Cloud/local resource semantics.
Do not add a dependency, new model, direct renderer system command, direct renderer network call, or real all-on/VRAM/model benchmark against the owner's active desktop.
Do not migrate Speech, Live2D or Avatar/Runtime pages in this slice.
contracts: ResourcesPage is typed presentation only. It receives bounded live view data and formatting/analysis values from App.vue, and emits refresh or model-control intent. It does not import Electron, Node, direct network APIs, persistence, NVIDIA tooling or model runtimes.
App.vue remains the sole owner of typed window.hinaDesktop resource calls, visibility-scoped polling, sample/history retention, error logging and allowlisted force-load/unload request dispatch.

The page can display physical telemetry, reservation/lease state and model residency, but must not turn unavailable/null metrics into zero, expose command lines/secrets or introduce raw system access into the renderer.
Owner model control stays bounded to the pre-existing typed IPC path and its scheduler/headroom enforcement; extracting markup must not make arbitrary model identifiers or actions executable.
Desktop renderer security tests include the extracted page and prove the resource boundary and dashboard modularity remain intact.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed IPC and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All Resources page markup is removed from App.vue and rendered through pages/ResourcesPage.vue.
The extracted page preserves refresh, bounded visual telemetry, model residency/lease/timeline explanation and owner force-control affordances through typed props/emits only.
Dashboard module documentation records ResourcesPage as extracted and names remaining legacy pages accurately.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and the repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
